name: cold-outbound
description: Dark-themed B2B services landing page with hero+social proof, value prop, 3-up service breakdown, tech stack grid, 3-tier pricing, final CTA, and footer. Modeled on agency / cold-email service sites.

design_tokens.background_uses: page background — usually dark navy or near-black
design_tokens.primary_uses: headlines, body text on dark bg (typically white)
design_tokens.accent_uses: CTAs, highlight tier, stat numbers, hover states (typically yellow/gold)
design_tokens.neutral_uses: card backgrounds, dividers (slightly lighter than bg)
